title: Bells Under the Shoals
summary: Salvage divers and ancestor-wardens at the Isle of the Drowned Ansei and the Coral-Choked Palace drive off shoal-plunderers disturbing the drowned orichalc vaults of old Yokuda.

hook.rumour: Plunder-skiffs have been dragging iron grapnels across the Sunken Temple of the Yokudan Kings, waking the drowned ancestor-lanterns beneath the shoals.
hook.notice: DROWNED ANSEI SALVAGE WARD: Divers and lookouts wanted to cut the plunderers' grapnel-lines and relight the Sunken Temple.

npcs.name: Warden of Isle of the Drowned Ansei
npcs.greet: Plunder-skiffs have been dragging iron grapnels across the Sunken Temple of the Yokudan Kings, waking the drowned ancestor-lanterns beneath the shoals.
talk: The trouble across the Sunken Isles of Yokuda began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Isle of the Drowned Ansei.
If you mean to help the Shoal-Wardens of Yokuda, start by checking the trail between Isle of the Drowned Ansei and Sunken Temple of the Yokudan Kings.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Isle of the Drowned Ansei
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Sunken Temple of the Yokudan Kings is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Sunken Temple of the Yokudan Kings toward Coral Choked Palace before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Isle of the Drowned Ansei so Reef-Warden Kemal can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Coral Choked Palace
npcs.greet: You made good time from Sunken Temple of the Yokudan Kings. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Coral Choked Palace.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Coral Choked Palace with a picked guard.
Once Coral Choked Palace is cleared, return to Isle of the Drowned Ansei to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Isle of the Drowned Ansei
npcs.greet: Reef-Warden Kemal awaits word on whether the crisis in the Sunken Isles of Yokuda has been contained.
talk: The elders of Isle of the Drowned Ansei have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of the Sunken Isles of Yokuda owes you a debt for standing between Isle of the Drowned Ansei and ruin.
